title: Towards On-Policy Data Evolution for Visual-Native Multimodal Deep Search Agents
abstract: arXiv:2605.10832v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Multimodal deep search requires an agent to solve open-world problems by chaining search, tool use, and visual reasoning over evolving textual and visual context. Two bottlenecks limit current systems. First, existing tool-use harnesses treat images returned by search, browsing, or transformation as transient outputs, so intermediate visual evidence cannot be re-consumed by later tools. Second, training data is usually built by fixed curation recipes that cannot track the target agent's evolving capability. To address these challenges, we first introduce a visual-native agent harness centered on an image bank reference protocol, which registers every tool-returned image as an addressable  reference and makes intermediate visual evidence reusable by later tools. translated_title: 面向视觉原生多模态深度搜索智能体的在线策略数据演化研究
translated_abstract: 多模态深度搜索要求智能体通过将搜索、工具使用与视觉推理串联起来，在不断演化的文本和视觉上下文中解决开放世界问题。当前系统存在两个瓶颈：其一，现有的工具使用框架将搜索、浏览或转换返回的图像视为瞬态输出，导致中间视觉证据无法被后续工具再次使用；其二，训练数据通常由固定的数据构建流程生成，无法跟踪目标智能体不断演化的能力。为应对这些挑战，我们首先引入了一个以图像库引用协议为核心的视觉原生智能体框架，该框架将每个工具返回的图像注册为可寻址的引用，使中间视觉证据能够被后续工具复用。在此框架之上，在线策略数据演化（ODE）运行一个闭环数据生成器，从正在训练的策略的推理轨迹（rollout）中跨轮次对自身进行迭代精炼。
tldr: 该论文提出以图像库引用协议为核心的视觉原生智能体框架，使中间视觉证据可被后续工具复用，并在此基础上设计在线策略数据演化（ODE）闭环数据生成器，利用被训练策略自身的推理轨迹跨轮次持续精炼训练数据，以跟踪智能体不断演进的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a visual-native agent harness centered on an image bank reference protocol that makes intermediate visual evidence reusable by later tools, and proposes On-policy Data Evolution (ODE), a closed-loop data generator that continuously refines training data across rounds from the rollouts of the policy being trained.
